mentions.name: dédédé
mentions.description: A not-for-profit website that invites people to casually share the good, bad, and why of urban spaces. Based in Kyoto, its posts are heavily Japan-centric, but it welcomes posts from all over the world.
mentions.audience: People interested in sharing experiences of urban spaces
